enemy_1.name: Bellhelm Sentry
enemy_1.description: A red sandstone golem hides under an oversized bronze bell helm that shrugs off the first blow, then pokes intruders with a rusty trident.

enemy_2.name: Tidy Shardling
enemy_2.description: A tiny crystal golem in a spotless stone ruff lets every curse slide right off and treats each visitor as a smudge.

enemy_3.name: Bog Belcher
enemy_3.description: A mossy clay golem whose glass belly sloshes with swamp acid, one hiccup away from bursting.

enemy_4.name: Vise Colossus
enemy_4.description: A basalt golem pries armor open with enormous bronze vise jaws while a jar of swamp acid sloshes on its back.

enemy_act_1_miniboss_1.name: Topiary Warden
enemy_act_1_miniboss_1.description: A hedge golem tries to trim every living thing into the same approved rectangle.

enemy_act_1_miniboss_2.name: Courtly Shears
enemy_act_1_miniboss_2.description: A slender bronze golem performs fussy little bows between rude, very sharp snips.

enemy_act_1_boss_1.name: Brood Cauldron
enemy_act_1_boss_1.description: A walking stone cauldron pours little golems out of its belly and insists they are its children.

enemy_minion_1.name: Pebbling
enemy_minion_1.description: A red clay pebble golem charges ahead on boots much too large for its body.

enemy_minion_2.name: Millring
enemy_minion_2.description: A millstone golem no bigger than a plate fusses over its rim before rolling into trouble.
